candidates.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw one NEW full-body transparent master of Ankilope for AnkiQuest's ordinary study streak. References 1 and 2 are the exact AnkiQuest-owned Ankilope identity and painterly style. Reference 3 is ONLY the benchmark for the size and golden-orange color of the streak flames; draw no cow features and do not copy its pose. Keep the little golden tan antelope's creamy muzzle, brows and belly, large dark brown eyes, huge brown-edged ears, two ribbed dark brown horns, dark cloven hooves, small brown-tipped tail, indigo scarf and matching indigo satchel with a gold button. Ankilope takes a bouncy forward step with one hind hoof lifted, one front hoof holding up a blank cream flashcard, the other raised in a determined cheer. Use two modest, crisp cartoon flames behind the sides and a small ember beside the card, separate from both eyes and ears. Proud, enthusiastic, unharmed. Match the reference fur texture, edges and proportions. No smoke, diffuse glow, background, ground line, copied confetti, text, symbols or frame. Transparent RGBA square, 1254 × 1254 px requested, center the complete silhouette with safe margins around ears, horns, hooves and tail.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one new full-body happy pose for Anki-tan by Shigeyuki, a CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative for the AnkiQuest art matrix. The first image is Shigeyuki's identity and traditional mark-making reference. The second image is the approved full-body proportions, outfit and rendering reference. Match the two Anki-tan references: thin dark hand-drawn contours with visible colored-pencil grain, light sky-blue loose hair, a white band with exactly three blue five-pointed stars (the middle one larger), gray puff sleeves and a pleated gray dress with white frills and a muted blue hem, blue star brooch, gray gloves, knee socks, gray strap shoes. Preserve the full-size proportions and sweet face. No words, watermark or unrelated props. She is happily greeting the learner: beaming open smile, gently curved delighted eyes, one gloved hand waving at shoulder height, holding a single unmarked flashcard in the other, feet close with one slightly lifted in a joyful bounce. Two small blank paper cards and two little blue or gold sparkles are enough. Both shoes, the full skirt, gloves, headband and the hair silhouette are inside the image. No frozen blanket, snow, tears, fire, burst, text, floor, backdrop, border or shadow. Single figure, properly transparent RGBA square, 1254 × 1254 px requested, with breathing room at the edges. Keep her design consistent with the given Anki-tan; create a new composition and expression.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one new full-body Anki-tan study streak pose for AnkiQuest. Anki-tan by Shigeyuki, CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. Image 1 is the original character. Match the two Anki-tan references: thin dark hand-drawn contours with visible colored-pencil grain, light sky-blue loose hair, a white band with exactly three blue five-pointed stars (the middle one larger), gray puff sleeves and a pleated gray dress with white frills and a muted blue hem, blue star brooch, gray gloves, knee socks, gray strap shoes. She stands proudly in a lively three-quarter view, eyes open and bright with a determined smile, one gloved hand raising a blank card near her shoulder and the other with a small encouraging fist. One small crisp amber flame beside the card and two short golden-orange magical flame shapes behind her to read as an ordinary streak. Put those accents apart from her blue star band, face, and costume, and keep her body unharmed. No smoke, giant fire halo, extreme blaze, glow, backdrop, writing, lettered cards or cropping. One full figure centered in a truly transparent 1254 × 1254 requested RGBA square.

Use case: illustration-story. Draw one NEW full-body streak pose of Anki-tan by Shigeyuki, CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative as part of AnkiQuest.
